protocol_2019: Five: no apreciado, bajo, medio, alto, extremo (1.6).
protocol_2025: Four: Bajo, Medio, Alto, Extremo (3.8; p. 11).
attribution_evidence: Moncloa 15/01/2025: "Desaparece el nivel de riesgo 'No Apreciado'". 2/2024 summaries (Consejo de Ministros 08/03/2024; DEPOL) still use no apreciado.
caution: Category labels changed with a recalibrated algorithm (Moncloa); individual transitions cannot be inferred.

protocol_2025: Bajo subdivided for management by judicial measures: <60 d with, <90 d without (p. 11; 6.1).
attribution_evidence: Moncloa 15/01/2025 describes the subdivision. DEPOL says 2/2024 "modifica la redacción del VPER-S" (content not given), so an earlier origin of the interval cannot be fully excluded.
caution: Published statistics do not split Bajo by judicial measures; workload cannot be computed.

protocol_2025: May raise at the end of each complete assessment (3.8; 6.2).
attribution_evidence: Instrucción 7/2016 rule 1.5 (thesis Annex 6, Module 2) and the 2019 preamble (p. 2).
caution: Frequency of overrides is unknown.

protocol_2025: Final decision adopted "en acuerdo o desacuerdo" by the officer; no machine learning; fixed cut-offs (p. 10).
attribution_evidence: Absent from 4/2019 and Protocolo Cero.
caution: Does not add a downward override: the operative clauses remain upward-only.

protocol_2019: Officers, corroborated sources; no direct questions to the victim save exceptions (1.3-1.5).
protocol_2025: Officers, corroborated sources; minimise "No se sabe" (3.4-3.6); no "no direct questions" clause.
attribution_evidence: Both texts.
caution: Input quality in practice is unobserved.

protocol_2019: Ex officio, stated to court/prosecutor (Cuestiones preliminares C).
protocol_2025: Same, under Protocolo Cero (3.5; p. 10).
attribution_evidence: Instrucción 5/2021 (Protocolo Cero, official text) added first-contact procedures, not the duty itself.
caution: v1 attributed this to 2021: corrected.

protocol_2019: Last VPR before transmission; no time limit (1.4).
protocol_2025: Maximum 72 hours (3.7).
attribution_evidence: Not found in the available summaries of 8/2021, 11/2022, 1/2023, 2/2024.
caution: Earlier origin not excluded.

protocol_2019: Indicators Si/No; special-relevance and minors diligencias (1.7).
protocol_2025: Indicators Si/No/NS; plus persistent-aggressor diligencia (3.9).
attribution_evidence: Persistent-aggressor report from Instrucción 8/2021 (press 21/12/2021); NS display first documented 2025.

topic: Form after a new complaint or breach
protocol_2025: VPR (4.2); also after a verified Cometa breach (8).
attribution_evidence: DEPOL's summary of 2/2024 still refers to "la VPER-C correspondiente".
caution: Operational meaning (a new VPR resets the assessment) needs interviews.

protocol_2025: VPER, unless linked to a possible reoffence (then VPR) (4.1).

protocol_2019: Bajo+ (and no apreciado with measures): after first judicial action, max 7 days (5.3-5.4).
protocol_2025: Medio+ (and Bajo with measures): max 15 days (4.3-4.4); Bajo without measures: no deadline stated.
attribution_evidence: Moncloa 15/01/2025 mentions a longer period for systematic reassessment of the highest-risk cases.
caution: Not a universal 7-to-15 change: 2019 bajo had a 7-day deadline; 2025 Bajo without measures has none.

protocol_2025: At least 7 days for Medio/Alto; Extremo may be earlier (4.5; 8.A).
attribution_evidence: Both texts.
caution: v1 read this as an exception to the maximum: corrected.
Only after the first VPER, active, without known incidents.

protocol_2025: Bajo without measures <90 d; Bajo with measures <60 d.
attribution_evidence: See T02.
caution: Procedurally, "Bajo without measures" takes over the 2019 no-apreciado interval.

protocol_2025: Only an upward variation (6.3).
attribution_evidence: Not found in the available summaries.
caution: Other reporting duties (new diligencias, inactivation oficios, resistant cases) remain.

protocol_2025: Annex II compulsory, cumulative, extras allowed (5.1; 5.6).
caution: Content of the floor changed: see the measure comparison.

protocol_2025: Escalate and record (5.7).
caution: Capacity is not measurable from the texts.

protocol_2019: No apreciado generally; bajo exceptionally; no measures; "no aconsejen lo contrario"; bajo: contact + 5.3 reassessment not raising the level (2.6).
protocol_2025: Bajo only; no criminal measures; circumstances must show "de manera fehaciente" the absence of conditions for a repeat; contact preferably in person; reassessment after the judicial action that granted no protection (7.1).
attribution_evidence: Consejo de Ministros 08/03/2024 (2/2024): interview "al menos una vez y de manera presencial"; DEPOL quotes 2/2024 keeping "no aconsejen lo contrario". 2025 softens in-person to "preferentemente" and turns the judgement into a positive finding.
caution: The judgement test changes on paper; how evaluators apply it is unobserved.

protocol_2025: "Se procederá a la Inactivación" (7.2.1).
attribution_evidence: DEPOL quotes 2/2024 as still "podrá INACTIVARSE".

topic: Inactivation when the victim cannot be located
protocol_2025: At least THREE months since last contact; then judicial police and an oficio to court/prosecutor (7.2.1).
attribution_evidence: La Marea (11/03/2024, quoting 2/2024) and DEPOL (13/03/2024): SIX months under 2/2024. 2025 sets three months.
caution: Against 2019 the 2025 rule looks stricter; against 2024 it is shorter. Primary 2/2024 text not seen.

protocol_2019: Any level, no judicial measures; report to prosecutor (2.8).
protocol_2025: Bajo or Medio only, no judicial measures; look into causes; oficio (7.2.2).
attribution_evidence: La Marea quotes 2/2024: no apreciado, bajo or medio without measures.
caution: Primary 2/2024 text not seen.

protocol_2025: Three criteria, 3-month minimum, exit with one VPER at Bajo + interview (7.4).
attribution_evidence: Created by Instrucción 2/2024 ("inactivación supervisada", Consejo de Ministros 08/03/2024). Per La Marea and DEPOL, 2024 used a 6-month Medio+ look-back, special relevance "en algún momento", a 6-month minimum, an evaluator-discretion entry criterion, and exit after two VPER-S at no apreciado. 2025 shortens these.
caution: Details of 2024 are grade C. Whether supervision intensifies protection in practice is unobserved.

protocol_2019: VPR if 6+ months since last assessment, else VPER-C (5.8).
protocol_2025: Always a new VPR; inform court/prosecutor (7.3.1).
VPER must give Medio+ unless measures in force; prison release in special-relevance cases: VPR + interview (7.3.2).
attribution_evidence: DEPOL notes 2/2024 restated the duty to reactivate; no threshold reported.

protocol_2025: Automated diligencia; criteria-bound communication to the victim; extra measures (8.C).
attribution_evidence: Instrucción 8/2021 (press 21/12/2021): measures, automated report, special relevance alto/extremo for other-victim checks. Instrucción 1/2023 (Moncloa 09/02/2023): communication criteria, five-year window, medio with special relevance.

protocol_2025: Same, plus OAVD referral and an oficio announcing inactivation (8.D).
attribution_evidence: Instrucción 11/2022 (Moncloa 16/12/2022) updated resistant-case procedures; its text is not public.
caution: Exact contribution of 11/2022 unknown.

protocol_2025: Agreed with the victim at first VPER or earlier; cyber measures; documented risk communication (5.3-5.5; Annex III).
attribution_evidence: PSP from Instrucción 7/2016 (Protocolo Cero preamble).
caution: A written plan is not evidence of use.

protocol_2019: Central unit uploads a case report (F).
protocol_2025: Same; the case is never inactivated (p. 11).

topic: Telling the aggressor the case is under police control
protocol_2025: Only with judicial measures (Annex II), plus 5.2 and persistent aggressors.
caution: Annex wording; practice unknown.

topic: Electronic monitoring request to the prosecutor
protocol_2025: Medio only with special relevance; every Alto+ case (Annex II).
attribution_evidence: Neither the 8/2021 nor the 1/2023 summaries mention it.
caution: The prosecutor and court decide whether a device is imposed.

protocol_2019: Frequent and random checks at the victim's home/work; random control of the aggressor (Anexo 1).
protocol_2025: No victim-site item at Alto (Medio's occasional checks carry over); random AND frequent surveillance of the aggressor, plus an occasional interview with him (Annex II).
caution: Shift of written intensity from victim-side to aggressor-side; delivery unobserved.

protocol_2025: Permanent protection "de manera presencial"; school surveillance unconditional; new digital identity advised.
Six-item block for any victim with minors in her care (Annex II).
Only "recomendable" "en la medida de lo posible" (Annex II header).
attribution_evidence: The academy summary of 1/2023 reports that compliance with aggressor-side measures had to be expressly recorded; not confirmed in an official source.
caution: Accountability trail for delivery is thin.
